title: Burial societies and insurance, and who is buried with music
summary: Allen asks how burial societies pay for bands, age limits, junior divisions, whether women or young people are buried with music, and passing-the-hat funerals.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: How does this burial insurance work? You know.
I never did get that straight. I don't know but I know I belong to one. You don't know how it works but you belong to one.
What do you mean? Is it buried after you? Yeah, yeah with the music and everything. Does that pay for the band?
Oh, that was talking about. I guess they put out enough money to pay for it. That's what I'm going to bury.
What kind of benefits does it have? That's what I'm getting there. They give you just...
Just bury the one I'm in.

That's all. That's all. And they give you just a lump sum of money for your family. I don't think it's going. That red light's on so... Yeah. That's just not all that. Uh... How do you have to be before you can join one of these clubs or societies to be buried? Well, I guess after 21. After 21.
After 21.
I think I've seen people younger than that. They have some junior divisions. Well, yeah. That's a junior. Junior societies. Yeah. They got them. Junior. Junior. They got them.
Junior. Arboration. Arboration. They say that. Who cares?
Anyway. And the women too.
Yeah.
Yeah.

Have you ever seen a woman buried with music? Yeah. I think I've seen people younger than that. I have some junior divisions. Well, yeah. In junior societies. Yeah. They got them. Junior. Arboration. Arboration. They say that.
Who cares? Anyway. Uh... They have the little junior... Junior guys out there. And the women too. Yeah.
Yeah.
Have you ever seen a woman buried with music?
No. Not yet.
I think Miss Cole was buried with music.
Well, I won't hear when she died. Yeah. Maybe she was. But I was in Chicago. Uh-huh.
Well, are young guys ever buried with music? I mean... Or do you have to be a certain age to be buried with music?
Young kids? Uh-huh. Yeah. Buried with music. Yeah. Well, if they belong to a juvenile, it's something to get a bandy bandy bandy with music. Yeah.
I don't think I've ever seen that. No. So I know the Young Men's Olympians has a senior and junior division.
I'm pretty sure they have been did, Jeff, but I can't remember who. I'm pretty sure they have been did. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I mean, you've seen that happen to you. Where they take a cigar box and raise the money to bury a guy. It's not in any organization.

Well, all I can say, that happened right around here not long ago. People, fellas who live like that and don't take care of, don't be into anything, got a lot of friends and things. Well, some part of this go around and pick up money from them. You know, they get as much of the thing is enough to bring it and buy it and fuel and everything to get him all straightened out, you know. They hired a band this time?
Well, if you get enough money. Yeah.
If you get enough money. But did that happen much in the olden times? Well, obviously no.
Because the average time you see a band, that guy was blowing to some, you know, art fellows
or some kind of big society. Uh huh. And I was like, I'm not sure. But if you stuff Zulus and all them kind of people, well they're better than people with music and things.
